cards.title: Frost Hollow
cards.text: Frost wolf, ice slime, frost spider, the yeti and its snowball, the icicle wraith, the frost spirit.
cards.why: Pale creatures on a pale floor: they read by their outlines. Tick the ones that fit the heroes' style; comment on any that don't.

items.label: Ice slime
items.text: Ice slime (enemies/frost-ice-slime.svg, art/enemies/ice-slime.svg, headR 49): the game's slime shape made of ice: glassy, white at the top left going clear blue at the edge, three shards frozen inside, a bright shine, two icicles where the slimes' point is. Was the slime drawn in code, turned pale.

items.label: Ice slime (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Icicle wraith
items.text: Icicle wraith (enemies/frost-icicle-wraith.svg, art/enemies/icicle-wraith.svg, headR 42): Ghost B, the cold ghost the designer picked and round 8 kept for this ("Make this the wraith. Cold ghost that spawns icicles"), exactly as it was, with icicles hanging off its shroud: a fringe of icy points along both sides and two at each sleeve's end, their roots tucked under the cloth. Was Ghost A turned b

items.label: Icicle wraith (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Frost spider
items.text: Frost spider (enemies/frost-spider.svg, art/enemies/frost-spider.svg, headR 54): a new spider in round 8's creature build (round abdomen, small head, two fangs, four smooth jointed legs a side; the front pair in the arm parts, so they strike): pale ice-blue, the legs frosted white from the knee down, a white frost-flake on the abdomen. Was the round-5 hunter spider turned blue.

items.label: Frost spider (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Frost spirit
items.text: Frost spirit (enemies/frost-spirit.svg, art/enemies/spirit-frost.svg, headR 34): the spirits' one shared shape, a comma: a round glowing core with the element's mark in it and a wisp of a tail sweeping back, tapering and curling to a point (#back, it sways); ice blue with a white six-armed snowflake. Every spirit is this shape in its element's colours with its own mark. Was Ghost A turned blue.

items.label: Frost spirit (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Frost wolf
items.text: Frost wolf (enemies/frost-wolf.svg, art/enemies/frost-wolf.svg, headR 35 as the wolf): the round-8 wolf as a white wolf of the ice: a pale blue-white coat, a shaggy mane of pointed white tufts, a cluster of ice shards grown along its back, a blue-grey tail tip, ice-blue claws. Was the wolf turned pale.

items.label: Frost wolf (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Yeti
items.text: Yeti (enemies/frost-yeti.svg, art/enemies/yeti.svg, headR 68), with its snowball (props/yeti-snowball.svg, art/props/yeti-snowball.svg): the round-8 troll's body plan (the designer: "the same shape and fighting style as trolls") in white fur: a huge hunched back under a tufted white coat, a small blue-grey face under a white fur hood with a scalloped fringe, a broad flat nose and two fangs down fr

items.label: Yeti (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

cards.title: Ember Deep
cards.text: Fire spider, hellhound, cinder bat, fire spirit and the Pit Lord.
cards.why: Each sits beside the recoloured stand-in it replaces. Live in 0.13.1. Tick the ones that fit the heroes' style; comment on any that don't.

items.label: Cinder bat
items.text: Cinder bat (enemies/ember-cinder-bat.svg, art/enemies/cinder-bat.svg, headR 44 as the bat): the round-7 bat the designer picked, its shapes as they were (check9.py: the copied code still gives that bat), charred black: the wing bones glowing orange like embers, a glowing rim on the wings, ears glowing inside, cracks round the back and sides of the head (none on the face: two over the eyes' place r

items.label: Cinder bat (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Fire spider
items.text: Fire spider (enemies/ember-fire-spider.svg, art/enemies/fire-spider.svg, headR 54): the frost spider's build as a spider of the pit: coal black, every knee glowing like a coal, a glowing orange hourglass and cracks on the abdomen, orange-hot fangs. Was the hunter spider turned red.

items.label: Fire spider (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Hellhound
items.text: Hellhound (enemies/ember-hellhound.svg, art/enemies/hellhound.svg, headR 35 as the wolf): the round-8 wolf made lean (a narrower capsule) and coal black, a burning mane of flame tongues streaming back round the neck, its tail ending in a flame, an ember stripe down the snout, dark red inner ears, bone claws. Was the wolf turned dark red.

items.label: Hellhound (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: The Pit Lord
items.text: The Pit Lord (enemies/ember-pit-lord.svg, art/enemies/pit-lord.svg, headR 68; the Forges' mini-boss, which wore the round-5 demon): a big demon in the heroes' bust build: dark red skin, no eyes, a dark scalp coming to a point on the brow, two great black ridged horns sweeping out and back, a grim mouth with two fangs, black iron pauldrons with spikes and forge-lit edges, molten cracks on the arms,

items.label: The Pit Lord (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Fire spirit
items.text: Fire spirit (enemies/ember-spirit.svg, art/enemies/spirit-fire.svg, headR 34): the spirits' comma in flame orange with a pale flame in the core. Was Ghost A turned orange.

items.label: Fire spirit (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

cards.title: Gilded Spire
cards.text: Fallen angel, the Twin Heralds, choir sprite, sun blade, both golems, the light and ward spirits.
cards.why: Each sits beside the recoloured stand-in it replaces. Live in 0.13.1. Tick the ones that fit the heroes' style; comment on any that don't.

items.label: Choir sprite
items.text: Choir sprite (enemies/spire-choir-sprite.svg, art/enemies/choir-sprite.svg, headR 42): a tiny singing cherub: golden curls, no eyes, its mouth open in an "o", a white collar with a gold edge, small white wings (#back), two little hands held up (they lift when it sings). Was the cherub turned pale.

items.label: Choir sprite (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Fallen angel
items.text: Fallen angel (enemies/spire-fallen-angel.svg, art/enemies/fallen-angel.svg, headR 56 as the angel): one of the host in the heroes' bust build, fallen: ashen skin, no eyes, long black hair, a dark violet robe with a dull violet trim, two dark wings rising behind, ragged (torn feathers of uneven length, gaps, notches), a dark spear with a pale violet blade under the right shoulder (it thrusts). Was

items.label: Fallen angel (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Gilded golem
items.text: Gilded golem (enemies/spire-gilded-golem.svg, art/enemies/gilded-golem.svg, headR 66): the golem's own shapes plated in gold: polished plates on the shoulder boulders and the fists, a polished gold front plate over its chest (the front that turns shots back), the rune white. Its own file, still the golem's design (ART-NEEDED: "the golem in gold plate"). Was the ogre turned gold.

items.label: Gilded golem (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Golem
items.text: Golem (enemies/spire-golem.svg, art/enemies/golem.svg, headR 66): a stone golem in the heroes' bust build: two great boulders for shoulders, a body stone behind a squarish head stone with a rune glowing on its brow (a diamond, no eyes), two great stone fists (they swing), weathered grey with a little moss. Was the ogre turned grey.

items.label: Golem (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.text: The Twin Heralds (enemies/spire-herald-light.svg, spire-herald-fallen.svg; art/enemies/herald-light.svg, herald-fallen.svg, headR 56): the same shape twice (ART-NEEDED: "its fallen twin: the same shape, dark wings, purple"): a tall herald in the bust build, gold plate on the shoulders over a robe, a winged helm with a plume, great wings rising behind, a long spear (it thrusts); the Herald of Light

items.label: The Twin Heralds (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: The Twin Heralds
items.text: The Twin Heralds (enemies/spire-herald-light.svg, spire-herald-fallen.svg; art/enemies/herald-light.svg, herald-fallen.svg, headR 56): the same shape twice (ART-NEEDED: "its fallen twin: the same shape, dark wings, purple"): a tall herald in the bust build, gold plate on the shoulders over a robe, a winged helm with a plume, great wings rising behind, a long spear (it thrusts); the Herald of Light

items.label: The Twin Heralds (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Light spirit
items.text: Light spirit and ward spirit (enemies/spire-light-spirit.svg, spire-ward-spirit.svg; art/enemies/spirit-heal.svg, spirit-ward.svg, headR 34): the spirits' comma, pale gold with a little sun, violet with a pale shield. Were Ghost A turned gold and violet.

items.label: Light spirit (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Sun blade
items.text: Sun blade (enemies/spire-sun-blade.svg, art/enemies/sun-blade.svg, headR 58): a floating golden sword seen from above, centred on its guard so it spins about it: a broad gold blade with pale glowing edges, a crossguard behind a sun disc with eight rays, a grip and a round pommel. Was the cherub turned gold.

items.label: Sun blade (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.text: Light spirit and ward spirit (enemies/spire-light-spirit.svg, spire-ward-spirit.svg; art/enemies/spirit-heal.svg, spirit-ward.svg, headR 34): the spirits' comma, pale gold with a little sun, violet with a pale shield. Were Ghost A turned gold and violet.

cards.title: Sunken Dunes
cards.text: Scarab, cobra, jackal guard, mummy, sand mage and dust devil, the sand serpent, dart trap, two spirits.

items.label: Cobra
items.text: Cobra (enemies/dunes-cobra.svg, art/enemies/cobra.svg, headR 48): a cobra reared with its hood spread, seen from above: a wide sandy hood with dark bands across it and a pale front edge, a small head with a forked tongue; behind it the body lies in a loose darker coil with pale bands, ending in a thin tail (#back). No eyes, no eye-spots on the hood. Was the lizardman turned sandy.

items.label: Cobra (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Dart trap
items.text: Dart trap (enemies/dunes-dart-trap.svg, art/enemies/dart-trap.svg, headR 45): set in a tomb wall: a sandstone slab along the wall behind it (#back: it stays on the wall while the head aims, as the game's turrets do), a round carved sun face with rays (no eyes) and a dark slot of a mouth with three dart points in it; the slab's back edge sits on the wall at the distance the game mounts it. Was the

items.label: Dart trap (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Dust devil
items.text: Dust devil (enemies/dunes-dust-devil.svg, art/enemies/dust-devil.svg, headR 68): a small whirlwind seen from above: three curved arms of sand sweeping round into a darker eye, paler at their outer edges (it spins whole). Was Ghost A turned sandy.

items.label: Dust devil (before)
items.text: The stand-in the game showed until now.

items.label: Jackal guard
items.text: Jackal guard (enemies/dunes-jackal.svg, art/enemies/jackal.svg, headR 54): a tomb guard with a jackal's head in the heroes' bust build: black fur, a long snout with a gold stripe, tall ears standing up with gold inside, a broad gold, turquoise and lapis collar over white linen; a gold-tipped spear under the right shoulder (it thrusts), a round bronze shield with a sun boss on the left. items.text: Mummy (enemies/dunes-mummy.svg, art/enemies/mummy.svg, headR 54): the bust build wrapped from head to fists in greyish old linen (greyer than the sand floor), bands round the head and no face showing, wrapped arms and fists (they swing), a long loose strip of bandage trailing back from the right shoulder and a short one on the left (#back). cards.title: Bosses
cards.text: The Goblin Chieftain as a goblin, the Winter Queen, the Gilded Seraph (and her fallen look) and her singers.
cards.why: The Chieftain kept the mohawk troll's build but has goblin skin, nose, grin and ears, a cleaver and war paint. Tick the ones that fit; comment on any that don't.

items.text: Choir singer (enemies/boss-choir-singer.svg, art/bosses/choir-singer.svg, headR 40; boss-seraph.js seraphSinger): the choir sprite's kin: golden curls, no eyes, its mouth open in an "o", a white robe with a gold collar, gold-tipped wings, an open hymn book held in both hands.
